insufficient staffing leading to neglect of basic care
I am concerned that the Waxham House Residential Care Home didn't recognise the obvious risks of infection of leaving an incontinent lady sitting in her own waste when she was prone to sacral sores
infection risk from prolonged exposure to waste

lack of escalation protocol for delayed nursing response

I am further concerned that there is currently no system in place at St Mary's Hospital to automatically contact the Coroner to refer the matter for investigation when a person who is the subject of a Safeguarding alert dies whilst an inpatient in the Hospital
